text.tspan: The FALCON030 is equipped with an IDE interface. IDE drives can be connected through an
internal 44-pin connector. Chip selects and direction control for the IDE interface are provided
by the COMBEL IC. The interface resides across the data bus using data bits 0-16. Four address
bits are used to control the IDE interface (A2-A4).
Data is transmitted from the SSI Transmit Shift
